title: Nauha Ye Sakina ka
body:
nauha ye sakina ka raha pyaas bujha do
darya se palat aao chacha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
murhjaye huwe hont hai kaatein hai zaban may
hai halq mera sookha hua pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo rann ko gaya jaise mujhe bhool gaya hai
ek ek ko mai deti hoo sada pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere chacha mere chacha mere chacha jaan
israar sakina ka raha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya na koi phir bhi mere pyaas bujhane
sun'ne ko to har ek ne suna pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai baithi hoo darwaze pa kab aaoge ammu
yun do na yateemi ki saza pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad pa meri koi deta nahi awaaz
kab tak mai karoo aah o buka pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tum se khafa thi na khafa hoo na rahungi
bas itni tamanna hai chacha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasaar aseeri ke nazar aane lage hai
bandh jaye na rassi se gala pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat ye pasay sheh thi sakina ki sadayein
pani may hai dam atka hua pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
